user.title: Zapette
user.description: A Zapette instance controls one TV. The parent code gives unlimited access.

plug.title: TV plug
plug.description: Choose the Zigbee plug that powers the TV (switch entity exposed by Zigbee2MQTT) and, if available, its power sensor.

data_description.plug_entity: Zapette keeps it off unless allowed.
data_description.power_entity: Used to detect when the TV is put on standby with the remote.

keypad.title: Keypad
keypad.description: Choose the Zigbee2MQTT keypad near the TV, or type its topic (`zigbee2mqtt/KEYPAD_NAME`). Leave empty for no keypad: codes can still be sent with the `zapette.submit_code` action.

data_description.keypad_topic: Only devices that send a typed code (`action_code`) are listed.
data_description.test_keypad: Type any code on the keypad to check it is received. The code is neither shown nor stored, and the TV is not turned on.

keypad_test_ok.title: Keypad received
keypad_test_ok.description: A code was received from {topic} (key: {key}). It was not checked, shown or stored.

keypad_test_timeout.title: Nothing received
keypad_test_timeout.description: No code was received from {topic} within {seconds} s. Check the keypad name in Zigbee2MQTT and that it is awake (press a key), then try again.

keypad_test_no_mqtt.title: MQTT unavailable
keypad_test_no_mqtt.description: The MQTT integration is not configured or not connected: the keypad cannot be tested now.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {tv_name}
reconfigure.description: Children, codes and settings are kept. Nothing switches the TV on or off.

reconfigure_plug.title: Plug of {tv_name}
reconfigure_plug.description: Children, codes and settings are kept. Changing the plug does not switch either plug.

progress.keypad_test: Type any code on the keypad {topic} and confirm it (waiting up to {seconds} s).

data_description.enabled: A disabled child cannot turn the TV on.

code.title: Code for {name}
code.description: 4 to 8 digits. Codes that are too simple (1234, 0000…) are refused.

template.title: Rules for {name}
template.description: Starting point for quotas and time slots; editable later via “Reconfigure”.

slots.title: Time slots
slots.description: Time slots for: {days}. End at 00:00 = midnight. Leave unused slots empty.

data.no_slot: No time slot (TV forbidden on these days)

options.default: Default (1 h on weekdays, 2 h Wednesday and weekend)

init.title: Settings
init.description:
Saved parents: {parents}

Changes are applied only after “Save and exit”.

parent.title: Parent code
parent.description: When editing, leave the code empty to keep the current one.

data_description.code: A parent code gives access without quota or time limits.

data.standby_cut: Turn the plug off on standby

data_description.tolerate_manual: If enabled, a plug turned on with its button or by another automation is not turned off again (the event is still sent).
data_description.standby_threshold: Below this power, the TV is considered off with the remote.
data_description.standby_delay: Time below the threshold before the plug is turned off.
data_description.standby_cut: On (recommended): detected standby ends the session and turns the plug off. Off (development setting): standby is only reported, the TV stays on and the session goes on.

keypad_settings.title: Keypad settings
keypad_settings.description: After too many wrong codes, the keypad is locked; a parent code or the `zapette.unblock_keypad` action unlocks it. The stop key, pressed alone (without a code), turns the TV off.

data_description.off_key: On the frient KEPZB-110, the padlock key is “Arm all zones”.

session_settings.title: Session settings
session_settings.description: Warning before the TV is turned off at the end of a session, and safety limit for parent sessions (parents have no quota nor allowed hours).

data.parent_max_hours: Maximum length of a parent session

data_description.warning_minutes: 0 = no warning. The `zapette_session_warning` event is fired at that moment.
data_description.warning_beep: If the keypad allows it, it beeps for a few seconds when the warning is given.
data_description.parent_max_hours: A parent session is turned off after this duration (with a warning). 0 = never.

error.name_invalid: The name must have 1 to 30 characters (letters, digits, spaces, - and ').
error.code_not_digits: The code must contain digits only.
error.code_length: The code must have 4 to 8 digits.
error.code_mismatch: The two codes do not match.
error.code_too_simple: Code too simple (repeated digits or sequence). Choose another one.
error.code_in_use: This code is already in use. Choose another one.
error.last_parent_code: The last parent code cannot be deleted.
error.parent_name_in_use: A parent already has this name.
error.tv_name_in_use: Another Zapette TV already has this name.

submit_code.name: Submit a code
submit_code.description: Submits a code as if typed on the keypad (same rules and lockout). Returns the decision.

unblock_keypad.name: Unlock keypad
unblock_keypad.description: Lifts the keypad lockout after too many wrong codes (does not turn the TV on).

start_session.name: Start a session
start_session.description: Starts a session remotely for a child or a parent (turns the TV on).

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: First name of the child or name of the parent.

ignore_rules.name: Ignore the rules
ignore_rules.description: Child only: no allowed-hours or quota check; the time is still counted, and the session stops at midnight and after the maximum length of a parent session.

stop_session.name: Stop the session
stop_session.description: Ends the running session and turns the TV off.

control_inactive.message: Control is suspended: turn “Control active” back on to drive the plug.

plug_unavailable.message: The plug is unreachable: check that it is plugged in and connected to the Zigbee network.

entry_not_loaded.message: This Zapette instance is not loaded.

profile_unknown.message: No child or parent has this name.

tv_in_use.message: A session is already running: stop it first.

outside_schedule.message: This child is outside their allowed hours.

quota_exhausted.message: This child has less than one minute left today.

plug_unreachable.title: {tv_name}: plug unreachable
plug_unreachable.description: The plug {entity_id} has been unreachable for more than 2 minutes; Zapette considers the TV off. Check that the plug is plugged in and connected to the Zigbee network. If the plug was replaced or renamed, choose the new one with “Reconfigure” on the Zapette integration page.

plug_off_failed.title: {tv_name}: plug cannot be turned off
plug_off_failed.description: The plug {entity_id} has not confirmed it is off for more than 2 minutes. Zapette keeps trying every 30 seconds. Check the plug in Zigbee2MQTT.

plug_missing.title: {tv_name}: no plug configured
plug_missing.description: This Zapette instance has no TV plug yet. Choose it with “Reconfigure” on the Zapette integration page.

keypad_unreachable.title: {tv_name}: keypad unreachable
keypad_unreachable.description: Zigbee2MQTT reports the keypad {topic} as offline. Children cannot use their code until it is back; remote actions still work. Check its battery and the Zigbee network. A battery keypad is only reported offline after a long silence (25 h by default in Zigbee2MQTT).

keypad_battery_low.title: {tv_name}: keypad battery low
keypad_battery_low.description: The battery of the keypad {topic} is at {battery} %. Replace it soon.

standby_cut_disabled.title: {tv_name}: the plug is not turned off on standby
standby_cut_disabled.description: Development setting: standby is detected but the TV stays on and the session goes on. Turn “Turn the plug off on standby” back on in Zapette → Configure → Plug settings.
